name: bga
description: Local-first voice assistant that teaches board game rules from your own rulebooks

scripts.verify: turbo run typecheck test lint build && biome check && node --test commitlint.config.test.mjs scripts/release-prepare.test.mjs
scripts.preflight: turbo run lint typecheck test && node --test commitlint.config.test.mjs scripts/release-prepare.test.mjs
scripts.prepare: husky && editor="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/scripts/git-commit-editor.sh" && git config --local core.editor "$editor" && git config --local sequence.editor "$editor"
